book.name: Maak
book.title: Maak Yesu Ye Weng Amun Maakbed Wongkoon

content: Awad Arewayiib Ibneniwenman Ongmoon
Kwane Yesu yoom ye kedmengkandeendan yoom bowan Galeli yara Gerasin ambibkin yaa yaniwen.
Kwane yanekoriwa, Yesu kuu parai motod aombed angkadoroone, karub awad arewayiib ibneniwen ye karub kuu botdem bob konombon aombed mene ye yaa durunenande monoon.

Karub kee botdem bob konombon aombed dobirimaan. Aron yemoon karub yenambed ye dingki yaa sein nongbed yenbenekorib yeeng baradbed ye yon ayoob dange yenbimaib, kumban nong kuu buruwadmene yeeng barad kangkon monmare dudmungkimaan. Ye aromkono kuu karub korem burudandoon kowe, awine yengbenindeban yiminban keriwen.
Aron korem awingyawiib amnoomiib kuu kwane botdem bob konombon aomiib aangko ariyiib kwangkambed doberemberene komkimame bot baradbed yemeren bungenabimaan.
Kwane ye kuu ambabbed Yesu wedmenekore, kabaanmo mene ye murubia arimbed dangbodin yiri bumangkoon.

Bumangkoone, Yesumbed yedmenoon, “Awad arewa, karub ye niindem aom kuu angkadere.” andoone, naawonmo baandoon, “Yesu, Korem Burudandoon Arimbed Ye God ye Mingki! Ebbed ne yaa komo kamandewed? God yaningko yaambed yedme kowe, ne yaa yewed darewoob kawe monmaruwaab!” andoon.
Yesumbed kaamonenoon, “Ewaningko kuu kane?” andoon. Andoone, yembed inandoon, “Naningko kuu Kadaareb, nub kuu yemoon kowe.” andoon.
Kwanandekore, Yesu yaa ambibkin bunangka benkiradmaab ande angkon ika ika eekmoon.
Awon amongkob wad yemoon kuu aangko kaat ok kebed yaambed anengkanan yarebiib kowe,
awad arewambed Yesu yaa eekme yedmiwen, “Nub kuu awon niindem aom winime ande yedmebko wenem.” andiwen.

Kwanandiiwe, yembed kwanime ande weng kondoone, angkadere wene awon niindem aom aomniwen. Awon wad yemoon korem kuu 2,000iib areb aangko kaat angkambed kirokmone ok yiri kabaane bubke konok anenib dukniwen.
Kwaniiwe, awon yi arian kuu kabaanmo wene taundaniib okad angkadaniib yaa daandiiwe, wengamberekorib wene komarewa keroon ande ika wedmok miniwen.
Kwane, mene Yesuyiib yaa nandekorib wedmiiwe, awad arewa yemoonbed ibneniwen kumbed angkadiriwen ye karub kuu inwaroon kumbed inamen amunmo kuyaa dibeen kowe, yi kuu uniwen.
Kwane, wedmiwendanbed awad arewambed ibneniwen kumbed angkadiriwen ye karub ye wengiib awon yaa komarewa keroon ye wengiib kuu menebiwendan yaa dakmiwen.
Kuyaambed nimakarubbed yi ambibkin aom kuu koronde wonok ande yobdoodmo kaamoniwen, Yesu yaa.
Kwane, Yesu kuu parai motod aom aomnoone awad arewambed ibneniwen angkadiriwen amun keroon ye karub kuu mene Yesu yaa eekme ne yoom wenem andoon.
Kumban, Yesumbed yedmoon, “Yii, eb ambiyoom wene Yarimanbed eb yaa komarewa kere mimyob keebdene eb dabab arene ongmebdoon kuu wene eb ambe awene yaa daande.” andoon.
Kwanandoone, karub kuu koronde wene ambibkin Dekapolis aom Yesumbed ye yaa komarewa kerunoon ye weng kuu andowe daandoon. Kwane daandoone nimakarub korem kuu binangkiwen.
Wonong Koyu Anam Bobneen Yoom Anikad Ye Wonong Yoom
Kwane, Yesu kuu parai motodbed ika bowan yara yane bid yaa doroona kadaareb yemoon kuu menebe ye angkara awanewandiwen.
Kuyaambed kurikuri ooni ye karub maa yaningko Yairus kuu kuyaa mene Yesu wedmenekore, ye yon yiri bumangkene okad yiri korok kankibine
Yesu yaa yobdoodmo eekme yedmenoon, “Ne dana mungkan bobnandamuun kowe, anam mene eb dingki yu yaa kowebko amun kerenu wadkeruk.” andoon.
Andoone, Yesu kuu ye yoom winiwen. Winiiwe, kadaareb yemoon kuu ye yoman wene nimingke awanewandiwen.
Kuyaa kuu wonong maa yu kuu wood andemwuroon kuu dowan kerindeban. Weeb wad ayoowiib kwamune doruun.
Yu kuu doktadan yaa od kowaune ongmimaib kumban dowan kerindeban yu od dowan kereen, kumban yu durud yewed kuu darewoob kereen.
Kwane, Yesu ye weng wengamberekoru, nimingkaib aombed yoman yaro mene yebkad yaa ema angkoroneneen,
amborom kuu yumbed meeneen kuu “Yebkad yaa angkoronaniin kuu amun keraniin.” andeen.
Kwane kuyaambed yu wood kuu kirod dowan keroone, yukareb meeneen, “Anam, ne kuu kuye durud yewed kara kuu dowan keroon kii!” andeen.
Kuyaambed Yesu kuu meenoon ye ongmi yaromkonombed maa yaa amun kerunoon kowe, amonombene kadaareb aom kaamondoon, “Kanembed ne ebkad yaa angkorowoon?” andoon.
Kwanandoone, ye kedmengkandeendanbed yedmiwen, “Eb wedmeewoo? Nimakarub eb yaa nimingkaib kowe, komande eb kuu kanembed angkorowoon andeeb kii?” andiwen.
Kumban Yesu kuu kanembed kwanoon ande kereknanmo deweneboon.
Kwane, wonong yu yaa komo keroon kuu yukaadkereen kowe, mene ye yon yiri bumangkenu, kiringmiyiib uniyiib kumbed korem anammo daaneen.
Kwane, yembed yu yaa yedmendoon, “Ne dana, kub anam andimbed ongmebdoona wadkereeb kowe, durud yewediibban dore amunmo wene.” andoon.
Yesu kuu kwane dakmeene, karub yena kuu Yairus yambiwoombed miniwen. Mene yedmiwen, “Eb dana kuu bobneen kii. Kwani kowe, Kedmengkandi korok kuu domoneneewo, maa yaa wonok.” andiwen.
Kwane, Yesu kuu yi weng wengamberedandekore, Yairus yaa yedmenoon, “Eb meenaab. No anam ande meene.” andoon.
Kwanekore, Pita yoom Yems yoom Yems ye daman Yoon yoom yaa wenem ande, karub yena kuu dobirime andoone, dobiriiwe winiwen.
Kwane wene Yairus yambib yaa nandekorib, Yesu kuu wedmoone nimakarub kuu wayirindenib amengiib naawonmo yuudiyiib kamiib
kowe, ye kuu ambiwoom wene yi yaa yedmoon, “Kee komarewa kwane wayirindenib yuudiyiib kamiib? Wonong koyu kee bobnindo, no unuk angkeen.” andoon.

Kumban yi kuu ye yaa ambon baaneniwen. Kwaniib kowe, “Bunangka angkanime.” andoone, yi korem kuu angkaniiwe, Yesu yoom awodki yoom awaan yoom ye kedmengkandeendan ayoobmim yoom kumbedmo koyu yu bob angkuun aom awuniwen.
Awunenib, yembed yu dingki yaambed awinendekore yedmoon, “Talita kum.” andoon ye weng id kuu “Dana, dembe.” andoon.
Kwane kuyaambed koyu kuu dembenu andowe dodkanmo dewenebeen. Kuyaambed yi kuu binangki darewoob keriwen. Yu kuu weeb wad ayoowiib.
Kwaniiwe, yembed weng yobdood yi yaa yedmendoon, “Karub yena yaa kuye weng kuu dakmaiwe yikaadkeraib.” andekore, “Animan maa kondibko anuk.” andoon.
